description: This file contains functions related to file reading and output printing, specifically for unit test common utilities in C. It includes a function to read a file into memory and handle errors, as well as a function to print the contents of a file and some input data.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into a memory buffer, handling errors and setting the length in the provided test_ut_memory_t instance.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file read into memory and a string representing KVP data, utilizing the read_file_into_memory function.
